neighbours.label: The tokens ' shorthand', ' shortcut' and ' junk' (an abbreviated or low-value stand-in for the real thing)
fire: For most engineers, the acronym is simply shorthand for the whole testing process.
There is no real shortcut to learning a new language well.
My uncle spends every Saturday sorting through junk at the flea market.
In her notes she used a private shorthand that nobody else could read.
The hikers found a shortcut over the ridge and arrived before noon.
Most of the email I get each morning is junk from shops I never visited.
Use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Z to undo the last change.
Critics say the word has become lazy shorthand for any kind of protest.
